themes.summary: Many buyers say the banner is simple, easy to set up, and works effectively for announcements and promotions.

hits.quote: Clean, professional, and very effective.
I connected the banner to my website without any issues.
Creating a banner with Answerly Banner was surprisingly easy, far more intuitive than I expected.
It does exactly what it promises
It's really easy to make banners.
Very useful for a SAAS business to make sure users are aware of new functionality.
It is working great and the config options cover my basic use case scenario.
It was a breeze to set up, and I love how customizable it is
Simple. Powerful + a great support crew to support it.
Setup - could not be easier
The banners are sleek and auto adjust sizing to fit desktop and mobile.
I already know that Answerly Banner will display a modern a slick Black Friday banner on my site next year.
